title: MZ Diagonal Movement + Single Sprite + More Frames

posts.author: 3rr0r1n5ynt4x
posts.body:
Hi,
I'm currently struggling to get the 8D character creator (
https://robertpinero.itch.io/8dchars
) sprites to fully work in MZ.
My problem: I can't find a plugin, or combination of plugins, that supports using the $ operator in the file name AND more than 3 frames (I want 7) AND diagonal characters.
Has anyone got this to work and can tell me what Plugins he used?

posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
You may want to check out Galv's plugins. There's a small demo here:
RPGMaker MZ Plugins
>> DOWNLOAD MASTER DEMO << (Last updated 2025.10.04) Layer Graphics Character Animations Character Shadows Message Busts Visual Novel Choices Shadow Darken Character Frames CF Step SE M…
galvs-scripts.com
This setup supports 8-directional sprites and more than 3 stepping frames, as well as stepping SEs and sprites for idle/walk/run/jump.

posts.author: Eliaquim
posts.body:
Hi there!
I have two plugins that can make it work.
Diagonal Movements + Diagonal Sprites:
Hakuen Studio Diagonal Characters for RPG Maker MZ by Hakuen Studio
Adds diagonal movement and diagonal sprites support!
hakuenstudio.itch.io
More than 3 frames:
Hakuen Studio Character Frames for RPG Maker MZ by Hakuen Studio
Increase the number of frames for character sprite sheets!
hakuenstudio.itch.io
They are compatible. You also need my core plugin (EliMZ Book)

posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
I'm guessing Eli's plugins will work for you, I just wanted to mention something...
A quick look at the demo I linked confirms that, by default, Galv's plugins treat all characters as "big" (i.e. 1 character per sheet): no
$
filename prefix necessary. So I assume you want multiple characters per spritesheet without sacrificing support for the extra stuff.
